The demo's check rules this disagreement decidable now and names the shared observable both claims bear on; it names no instrument, so none is recorded. This is a statement about the two claims, not a verdict on either theory. The dimension is a dimension of theoretical commitment, not a quantity, so no margin or floor applies. The claim statements in the linked claim cards are reviewed paraphrases with page locators, not quotations. The demo marks this pair as a type divergence: the two claims are different kinds of claim (constraint and substrate).

left.statement: The exclusion postulate restricts the locus of consciousness to a single maximally irreducible system (complex), not any subset or superset.
left.direction: “The exclusion postulate restricts the locus of consciousness to a single maximally irreducible system (complex), not any subset or superset.” (c010) — expected on shared observables: regional_decoding

right.statement: The locus of conscious processing is a large-scale prefrontal-parietal (and cingulate/temporal) cortical network, not posterior sensory cortices alone.
